manus: You don't need a PS5 to play GTA 6. If you have an old Xbox One, you can stream it with Xbox Cloud Gaming. Xbox confirmed it works from launch day. Buy the game on your Xbox account, then choose Play with Cloud Gaming. It streams with Xbox Series S graphics, and Microsoft recommends at least 20 megabits of internet. The catch: cloud time depends on your plan, and it's not available in every country. Follow for more GTA 6 tips.
